items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Gerald Clark and his calypso band.

ctx.x: No table cloths, and Zutty said to him you have to put some table cloths on, fix the place up. All these fine people coming in you know.
It was the calypso band wds drawing them in. Gerald Clark and his calypso band.
Oh that was alternating with you?
